Source answer for frozenab94798: no current scoped-row ABI or private fill_span contract requires observable logical-X store order WITHIN this one constant-colour span. Exact paused/drained hidden-page lease and byte/mask/lifetime rules permit your stated permutation; this is supported local consumer logic, not a new API/workaround or conversion endorsement.

For cached p<=3, s aligned4/countpositive multiple4/no end wrap, every XOR-mapped complete quad is exactly the same four distinct bytes. Each gets one F(v)=(v&P)|(C&M) with cached P/M and colour by value; disjoint-byte operations commute even with overlapping masks. Keeping all span/row/call order preserves between-row aliases. Do not extend it to row regrouping/coalescing, source-dependent colours or mid-span metadata reads.

Concrete early-exit detail: retain baseline linear branch and native count0 return BEFORE fetching rows[y]/forming a new row+start pointer. Predicate failure must go straight to unchanged scalar behaviour. The same unsigned s=(x_bias+x) result is valid for this proof; the end guard is not a new proof that initial addition did not wrap or that allocation bounds hold. Respect existing admitted rectangle/row_bytes, including protected prefix/suffix, and use actual per-row pointer only.

BEGIN pause/drain and finite-frame ownership exclude supported concurrent partial-image observation/writers; ordinary drawing guards BUSY during frame lease. No concurrent XOR/RMW safety added. Keep byte accesses, safe PSRAM compiler policy and actual barriers; MEMW orders memory, not atomicity/exclusion. Consumer's planned actual target/output/failure checks own candidate qualification, not this source proof. No new owner test/build/census/reviewer/target or extra approval, and current022 unchanged.
